response: Antibiotics do not decrease post-tonsillectomy morbidity. In fact, research has shown that post-tonsillectomy antibiotics did not prove to have a role in minimizing postoperative morbidity. Instead, other methods such as the use of topical ropivacaine have been found to be effective in reducing pain and post-operative analgesic requirements in pediatric patients. Therefore, antibiotics are not recommended for reducing morbidity after tonsillectomy.
